existing_group_assignments.rationale: Increased lipid accumulation without a tissue qualifier is the same process as the general event in this group, which is paired with a tissue-specific form (small intestine steatosis).
Activation of HIF1α shares the HIF-1 alpha object with the existing events but describes a distinct process (activation vs transcription or heterodimer levels).
Activated BMP/TGF-beta pathway shares the TGF-beta object with the existing group but is a distinct process or scope.
